hooks.command:
cd /home/user/club-manager && BACKLOG="backlog/BACKLOG.md"; TODO_DIR="backlog/todo"; if [ ! -f "$BACKLOG" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "No backlog found."}'; exit 0; fi; SUMMARY="=== BACKLOG — session start ===

"; SUMMARY+="$(cat "$BACKLOG")

"; SUMMARY+="--- Priority order (High → Medium → Low) ---

"; for priority in High Medium Low; do files=$(grep -rl "\*\*Priority:\*\* $priority" "$TODO_DIR" 2>/dev/null | sort); if [ -n "$files" ]; then SUMMARY+="[$priority]
"; for f in $files; do title=$(head -1 "$f" | sed 's/^# //'); SUMMARY+="  • $title
"; done; SUMMARY+="
"; fi; done; printf '{"systemMessage": "%s"}' "$(echo -e "$SUMMARY" | sed 's/"/'''/ g; s/$/\n/' | tr -d '
')"

cd /home/user/club-manager && TODO_DIR="backlog/todo"; COMPLETED_DIR="backlog/completed"; todo_count=$(ls "$TODO_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); completed_count=$(ls "$COMPLETED_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); MSG="=== SESSION END — Backlog review ===

${todo_count} feature(s) remaining in todo/, ${completed_count} in completed/.

Before finishing:
  1. Did you complete any features? Move their .md to backlog/completed/, add Completed: date, check off criteria, remove from BACKLOG.md.
  2. Did you discover new work? Add it to backlog/todo/ and link it in BACKLOG.md.
  3. Did priorities change? Update the Priority field in any affected .md files.
"; printf '{"systemMessage": "%s"}' "$(echo -e "$MSG" | sed 's/"/'''/ g; s/$/\n/' | tr -d '
')"
